%@ 与 %@ 自动互译；遇到其他语言或无法识别时，默认译为 %@。: Automatically translate between %@ and %@. Other or unrecognized languages are translated into %@.
HaHa翻译在这台 Mac 上识别与翻译文字，不把原文、译文或截图发送到翻译服务:
HaHa Translate recognizes and translates text on this Mac. It does not send source text, translations, or screenshots to a translation server.

The app accesses the network only when you choose to download a model or open an external support link. The model host receives network information needed to deliver the download, such as your IP address. The request contains no translation content.

Your glossary and optional history stay on this Mac and can be deleted in the app. Models can be deleted separately without affecting your glossary. Screenshots are processed during recognition and are not saved by default.

Contact: sapplex@icloud.com
一段文字，一扇通往新世界的窗。: A passage of text. A window to a new world.
下载一次，把翻译能力留在你的 Mac。: Download once. Keep translation on your Mac.
不同原文语言都译为同一个目标语言。: Translate every source language into one target language.
两种模型均来自腾讯 Hy-MT2，使用 Apache 2.0 许可。下载自官方: Both models are from Tencent Hy-MT2 under the Apache 2.0 license. Downloads come from the official Hugging Face repositories and are checked for integrity. File size is not the same as memory usage. The standard model needs more disk space and memory; translations should still be reviewed in context.
为产品名、专业术语指定译法，\n让每次阅读更连贯。:
Set preferred translations for product names and terms
to keep your reading consistent.
为熟悉的名字，提供你偏好的译法。: Give familiar names your preferred translations.
主题随系统自动适配浅色与深色外观。: Themes adapt to your system's light or dark appearance.
也可以在任意应用复制文字，\n按 ⌥D，随手翻译。:
Or copy text in another app
and press ⌥D to translate.
仅匹配原文中的词条，并把期望译法提供给模型。适合产品名称和常用术语，译文仍可按上: Matching source terms are passed to the model with your preferred translations. Useful for product names and common terms; review the result in context.
仅改变应用界面的语言，不影响原文与译文。: Changes only the app interface, not your source text or translation.
只删除所选模型文件。之后可以重新下载，你的术语表不会受影响。: Only the selected model will be deleted. You can download it again later. Your glossary is not affected.
回看读过的内容，记录只属于你。: Revisit what you've read. Your history stays yours.
在这里输入，或粘贴一段文字…: Type or paste some text here…
好译文，正在路上。: Your translation is on its way.
开启历史后，完成的翻译会显示在这里。\n记录不会上传或同步。:
Enable history to see completed translations here.
Records are never uploaded or synced.
快捷键冲突时会在启动后提示。截图权限只在你第一次截图时申请。: Shortcut conflicts are reported at launch. Screen access is requested only when you first capture a selection.
把世界，读成自己的语言。: Read the world in your language.
推荐自动识别。短词或多义词可手动指定原文语言，主窗口也可随时调整。: Automatic detection is recommended. For short or ambiguous words, choose the source language manually. You can also change it in the main window.
文字与截图只在你的 Mac 处理。\n下载模型后，无需联网。:
Text and screenshots are processed on your Mac.
After downloading a model, no connection is needed.
无需登录，没有广告或使用追踪。模型下载需要联网；原文、译文与截图只在本机处理。历: No login, ads, or usage tracking. Model downloads need a connection; source text, translations, and screenshots are processed locally. History is off by default.
最多 200 条术语；原词限 80 字符，译法限 120 字符。: Up to 200 terms. Source terms can have 80 characters and preferred translations 120.
期望译法，例如：工作空间: Preferred translation, e.g. 工作空间
清空后无法恢复，当前编辑区的文字不受影响。: This cannot be undone. Text in the current editor is not affected.
翻译时不联网，不需要账号或 API Key。: Translation works offline. No account or API key needed.
许可文件未找到，请联系 sapplex@icloud.com。: License file not found. Please contact sapplex@icloud.com.
请选择官方 %@。导入时会核验大小和 SHA-256。: Choose the official %@ file. Its size and SHA-256 are checked during import.
连续翻译可复用已加载的模型。超过保温时间后自动释放，下次翻译会重新加载。: Consecutive translations reuse the loaded model. Memory is released after the idle period; the next translation reloads it.
适用于支持文本服务的应用。如果没有此入口，可在系统设置 → 键盘 → 键盘快捷键: Works in apps that support text services. If the entry is missing, enable it and assign a shortcut in System Settings → Keyboard → Keyboard Shortcuts → Services. You can also copy text and press ⌥D.
选中文字后，在当前应用的「服务」菜单中选择「使用HaHa翻译」；部分应用也会在右: Select text, then choose Translate with HaHa from the current app's Services menu. Some apps also show Services in the context menu.
首次下载轻量模型后，即可离线使用。你也可以导入已有模型。: Download the lightweight model once to translate offline, or import a model you already have.
默认不保存。开启后，最多保存 100 条在本机；关闭后停止新增，已有记录可手动清: Off by default. When enabled, up to 100 records are saved locally. Turning it off stops new records; existing history can be cleared manually.
